name: zovo-image-preview
description: Image preview in the gutter and on hover for image paths in code, CSS url(), Markdown, HTML, JSX imports, SVG and data URIs. Shows type, pixel size and file size. Resolves @, ~ and tsconfig paths. Local files only, offline.

imgPreview.gutter.description: Show a thumbnail in the gutter next to each line that has an image path or a data:image URI.

imgPreview.hover.description: Show the image, its type, pixel size and file size when you hover an image path.

imgPreview.hoverMaxSize.description: Longest side of the image in the hover, in pixels. Small images are never scaled up.

imgPreview.aliases.markdownDescription: Extra path prefixes, for example `{ "@images": "src/assets/images", "#": "app" }`. Values are relative to the workspace folder or absolute. tsconfig.json and jsconfig.json `paths` are read on their own.

imgPreview.publicFolders.markdownDescription: Folders searched for paths that start with `/` (the web root), such as `/logo.png` served from `public/`.

imgPreview.maxFileSizeMB.description: Images larger than this are measured but not drawn in the gutter or the hover.

imgPreview.exclude.description: Glob of folders the Pro tools skip.

imgPreview.weightMaxKB.description: Image weight report (Pro): files larger than this many KB are flagged.

imgPreview.weightMaxSide.description: Image weight report (Pro): images wider or taller than this many pixels are flagged.

imgPreview.archiveFolder.description: Find unused images (Pro): folder, in the workspace folder, that confirmed unused images move to. Their folder structure is kept, and Undo moves them back.

imgPreview.showProTools.description: Show the Zovo Pro tools (unused images, broken references, weight report) in the Command Palette and the Explorer menu. Everything free stays visible.

imgPreview.askForRating.description: Ask once for a Marketplace rating after the extension showed images on two occasions at least 30 minutes apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. Nothing is sent anywhere.

imgPreview.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free viewers and Zovo Pro links at the bottom of the image hover. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Image Preview
walkthroughs.description: See the images your code, styles and docs point to, without leaving the editor.

steps.title: Thumbnails in the gutter
steps.description:
Open any file that names an image: a JSX import, a CSS url(), a Markdown image, an HTML src or srcset, or a data:image URI. A thumbnail shows in the gutter next to the line.
[Open the sample files](command:imgPreview.openSample)

media.altText: A TSX file in VS Code with image thumbnails in the gutter and a hover that shows a PNG with its pixel size and file size.

steps.title: Hover for size and type
steps.description: Hover a path to see the image, its type, its size in pixels and on disk, and links to open it or show it in the Explorer. Paths with @, ~, a leading / (public folder) or tsconfig paths work.

steps.title: Aliases and settings
steps.description:
Add your own path prefixes, choose the hover size, or turn the gutter off.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22imgPreview%22%5D)
